visualCharacteristics.purpose: accordion beside a photo that swaps to the open item image
descriptions: Centered H2; rounded photo with an orange offset block on the left; on the right four outlined rounded accordion items (Getting to Know Orlando open, Access Planning Resources, Explore Places to Stay, Try OPAL AI), each with text and 'Explore' link; the photo swaps to the open item's image.

contentPattern.structure: label cell | content cell (text, links, optional image); image may also be its own cell

usage.description: 4 accordion items, each with its own image, title, description and Explore link

reuseGuidance: Use when each accordion item has its own image. One item open at a time.
